description: Tighten prose against a rule catalog: cut needless words, restore buried verbs and the active voice, and give paragraphs a spine. Checks sentence-level rules (needless words, intensifiers, hedge stacks, negative form, nominalizations) and paragraph-level structure (topic sentence, one topic, consequent order), citing rule IDs. Tightens toward the author's measured density, never past it. Triggers: tighten, tighten style, omit needless words, wordy, too wordy, cut the fat, edit for concision, copyedit, style rules, paragraph structure, active voice.
